actual_source_parser: Installed PostCSS/value-parser plus literal HTML stylesheet parser; actual and synthetic cases use stylesheetLoaders.mjs.
service_worker: restyle only clones existing stylesheet URLs after current hashed-asset recovery; no candidate file enumeration.
printing: collectStyles copies already-loaded DOM styles/links into the print iframe; no old file import.
appearance: Updates classes/data attributes and inline variables, not stylesheet file paths.
lazy_retry: Both native/copied lazyWithRetry retry an initially failed chunk URL. Initial literal imports and all roots/globs are audited; no arbitrary copied stylesheet enumerator.
other_injected_styles: Leaflet/Journey marker helpers inject code-defined CSS strings, not these files; PDF external font URLs are unrelated.
tailwind: Existing content globs include application HTML/JS/JSX/TS/TSX; deleting the old page can change orphan utility generation even though no runtime importer exists. Compare complete compiled output separately.
native_styles: Native global/dashboard/collections CSS and all order/cascade configuration remain byte-exact. Native witnesses in prototype-proof.json.
